note: Explicit EUR/ha rates. Amounts are only ever computed from this table; a missing key means the corresponding amount is not reported rather than guessed.

rate_notes_es.unit_rate_eur_ha: Tarifa basica por hectarea de la ayuda base. Sin valor publicado en los documentos de referencia: debe cargarse por el administrador.
rate_notes_es.practice_rate_eur_ha: Tarifa por hectarea de la practica de eco regimen (Siembra Directa P4 / Cubiertas Vegetales P6). Sin valor publicado: debe cargarse por el administrador.
rate_notes_es.multiannual_bonus_eur_ha: Complemento de plurianualidad por mantener la misma practica durante dos anos consecutivos.

rate_notes_en.unit_rate_eur_ha: Base aid rate per hectare. No published figure in the reference documents: must be supplied by an administrator.
rate_notes_en.practice_rate_eur_ha: Eco-scheme practice rate per hectare. No published figure: must be supplied by an administrator.
rate_notes_en.multiannual_bonus_eur_ha: Multi-year bonus for keeping the same practice on the same parcel for two consecutive years.
